title: Distribution manifest (D-118)
description: A preset bundle of modules, packs, skills and views that does one job. The default modules every kernel has (kernel-mcp, validator-shacl, belief-corroboration, pack-loader, ui) are not listed.

does.description: What it does, in one sentence.

skills.description: Modules (also in modules) that carry a skill file.

views.description: View modules (also in modules) the UI lists for this distribution; no others are shown.

demo.description: Which demo loads its data: `kk demo --distribution` plays interview and order-to-cash; devops is scripts/e2e_devops.sh's overlay.

serve.description: The parts `kk serve --only` runs (KK_SERVE_PARTS); default: the stack's own.
